status: proposal: projection, window and chunk convention await integration; hex scale awaits the Owner
title: Europe and its approaches, 1798-1815
covers: Iceland to the Caspian, the North Cape to Cairo: every European theatre of the period, with North Africa, Egypt, the Levant, Anatolia, the Caucasus and north-west Persia.
units: km east (x) and north (y) of the projection centre

formulas.forward: With R the sphere radius, (l0, p0) the centre and (l, p) a point, all in radians: k = R * sqrt(2 / (1 + sin p0 sin p + cos p0 cos p cos(l - l0))); x = k cos p sin(l - l0); y = k (cos p0 sin p - sin p0 cos p cos(l - l0)).
formulas.inverse: rho = sqrt(x^2 + y^2); c = 2 asin(rho / (2R)); p = asin(cos c sin p0 + y sin c cos p0 / rho); l = l0 + atan2(x sin c, rho cos p0 cos c - y sin p0 sin c).
formulas.pixel: At a level with u km per pixel: px = (x - window.west) / u; py = (window.north - y) / u. Pixel (0, 0) has its top-left corner at (west, north).
formulas.why: Equal-area: every hex laid over the map covers the same amount of ground wherever it is. Shape distortion stays under about 4% across the window.

chunks.placement: Each chunk is 516 x 516: a 512 inner square with a 2 px skirt that repeats its neighbours' pixels. Anchor is the centre. Chunk (row, column) is drawn with its centre at ((column + 0.5) * 512, (row + 0.5) * 512) in level pixels, times the level's display scale.
chunks.display: Level 0 is declared at display size 516 (one art pixel per logical unit). If the Owner picks the finer hex scale below, the same chunks are shown at 1032 until level 1 exists.
chunks.higher_levels: Level n has 2^n times the pixels per km and 4^n times the chunks; the painter renders any level from the same recipe. Not built yet.

hex_scale.status: awaiting Owner; not baked into any image
hex_scale.note: The grid is laid over the map by the game: hex centre = origin + (64 * (column + (row % 2) / 2), 54 * row) logical units, as in ASSET-SPEC.

options.art: level 0 is one art pixel per logical unit; level 1 would double sharpness
options.feel: Paris to Vienna 9 hexes, Paris to Moscow 21. A board that fits a phone; Europe is one theatre of a world game.

options.art: needs level 1 (four more batches) to match the density of level 0 at the other scale
